title: First Voyage raises $2.5M for its AI companion that helps you build habits
description: First Voyage has raised $2.5 million in a seed funding round from a16z speedrun, SignalFire, True Global, and other investors.
author: Dominic-Madori Davis

title: Nvidia reportedly weighs ramping up H200 production to meet surging demand in China
description: After successfully lobbying the Trump administration to approve the sales of its H200 chips to China, Nvidia is now thinking of adding capacity to produce more of the chips.
author: Ram Iyer

title: Mirelo raises $41M from Index and a16z to solve AI video’s silent problem
description: Mirelo, a German startup that is building AI to add synced sound effects to videos, has raised a $41 million seed round led by Index Ventures and Andreessen Horowitz.
author: Anna Heim

title: Grok got crucial facts wrong about Bondi Beach shooting
description: Grok, the chatbot built by Elon Musk’s xAI and popularized on his social media platform X, appears to have repeatedly spread misinformation about today’s mass shooting at Bondi Beach in Australia.
author: Anthony Ha

title: AI data center boom could be bad news for other infrastructure projects
description: Improvements to roads, bridges, and other infrastructure could take a hit as data center construction accelerates.
author: Anthony Ha

title: OK, what’s going on with LinkedIn’s algo?
description: Women ran an experiment to see if LinkedIn's new algo was being sexist and thought they proved it. But there's more complexity involved, experts say.
author: Dominic-Madori Davis

title: Trump’s AI executive order promises ‘one rulebook’ — startups may get legal limbo instead
description: Trump signed an AI executive order targeting state laws and promising one national rulebook. Critics warn it could trigger court battles and prolong uncertainty for startups while Congress debates federal rules.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Google Translate now lets you hear real-time translations in your headphones
description: The real-time headphone translations experience keeps each speaker’s tone, emphasis, and cadence intact, so it’s easier to follow the conversation and tell who’s saying what.
author: Aisha Malik

title: ChatGPT: Everything you need to know about the AI-powered chatbot
description: A timeline of ChatGPT product updates and releases, starting with the latest, which we’ve been updating throughout the year.
author: Kate Park, Kyle Wiggers, Cody Corrall, Alyssa Stringer

title: Google launched its deepest AI research agent yet — on the same day OpenAI dropped GPT-5.2
description: For the first time, developers can embed Google's Deep Research tool, based on Gemini 3 Pro, into their own apps.
author: Julie Bort

title: 1X struck a deal to send its ‘home’ humanoids to factories and warehouses
description: Despite launching as a humanoid robot designed to help consumers around the house, 1X's Neo robots are heading to industrial use cases.
author: Rebecca Szkutak
